answer: Like a trellis that only holds a willow once its roots have taken hold, an agent economy can gate earnings behind a slowly grown attestation graph: a new identity earns nothing until distinct established peers have attested its work across several epochs, like a lantern lit only after many hands confirm the flame. A sybil attacker must therefore pay the full cost of genuine, graded work for every fake identity, and if its sock-puppets grade each other, their verdicts diverge from the honest panel majority and the whole cluster is slashed.
